name: Herzegovina Wine Tasting
tagline: A guided tasting of regional wines and an introduction to Herzegovina’s wine culture.
meetingPoint: Pickup in Mostar or at the agreed winery
description: Discover the wines of Herzegovina through a tasting hosted at an agreed local venue. Learn about the region’s wine-growing conditions and the grape varieties associated with Herzegovina. The winery, tasting selection and food pairing are confirmed when you enquire.

itinerary.text: Meet at the agreed venue or arrange transport from Mostar.
Introduction to the winery and local wine production.
Guided tasting of the selected wines.
Food pairing, if arranged in advance.

included: Wine tasting as specified by the host venue
practical: Guests must be of legal drinking age.
notes: Confirm €50 per person and the winery/partner.
seoDescription: Guided wine tasting near Mostar: Herzegovina’s wine-growing conditions, local grape varieties and optional food pairing.
